messages:
support-engine: P1 incoming — customer 'AcmeMaps' reporting intermittent 502/504s from Hosted API since ~09:12 PDT. They see it on map tile generation and large chat requests. Repro steps below.

support-engine: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'
  -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

customer-rep: customer says it started right after a billing sync job ran, and they noticed spikes on their side too (quota changes). They want root cause and ETA.

jamie: grabbing traces. initial look: large tail latency on authz/billing service (authz-checks) starting 09:11, coincident with surge. Envoy upstreams show RST/timeout to authz cluster.

sre-bot: alert — upstream_latency_percentile(99, cluster=authz-upstream) spiked to 6.5s at 09:12 (threshold 2s).

leo: seeing many 502s in edge logs with upstream_reset and 504s when timeout exceeded. Likely the edge timed out waiting on authz calls.

maria: any recent deploys?

jamie: no infra deploys at 09:10-09:13. There was a scheduled billing sync job at 09:09 that queried entitlements for many customers; authz backend CPU and Redis connection queues spiked.

oncall: rolling a mitigation — increasing envoy cluster timeout from 3s -> 8s for authz cluster on edge (hot patch), and enabling cached-entitlement fallback so requests can proceed if authz backend slow. Pushing now.

leo: hotpatch applied to edge pools in us-west-2 (canary -> 50%). Config snippet: 
```
cluster.timeout: 8s
retry_policy: { retry_on: "reset,connect-failure", num_retries: 2 }
```

maria: also added short-lived circuit breaker on authz upstream (max_connections lowered) to stop pileups on backend.

jamie: after canary shift, authz p99 dropped to ~1.2s and 502s fell by ~85% in the canary pool. Rolling to remaining pools.

support-engine: passed mitigation notes to AcmeMaps. Asked them to try again; they reported reduced errors.

customer-rep: customer confirmed generation requests are succeeding now, but they'll monitor for the rest of the day. They asked for postmortem and what we changed.

maria: will file a short postmortem (incidents/) — root cause: billing sync caused authz hotspot and Redis connection pressure leading to upstream timeouts and edge 502s. Mitigations: increase edge timeouts, cached-entitlement fallback, circuit-breaker on authz, and a fix to spread billing-sync reads.

oncall: follow-ups: 1) add rate-limiting/quota guard on billing-sync job, 2) increase authz autoscaling buffer, 3) add synthetic canary checks for authz latency pre-schedule.

support-engine: closing for now, will reopen if customer sees regressions. :thumbsup:
